newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Interstate lowers Brinker.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Interstate lowers Brinker.

text.p: -- Interstate/Johnson Lane said it downgraded Brinker International Inc to sell from neutral, citing a "significant earnings shortfall" in the company's fiscal second quarter.

-- "The company announced earnings of $0.15 a share versus $0.17 a year ago versus expectations of $0.19, which had already been revised downward from previous hopes of $0.21," an Interstate report said.
-- The stock was not immediately open after closing Tuesday at 15-1/4.
